children: Digital bank Nu said it will enter the U.S. market and launch Nu Global, a multi-currency digital account. According to Foresight News, Nu Global can convert funds into USDC or EURC, supports local and international transfers with no fees, and allows users to hold and trade Bitcoin and Ethereum in the app.
The company said it plans to expand service coverage to Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, and the United States over the next few months.

title: Nu to Enter U.S. Market With Multi-Currency Digital Account Nu Global
